name: Livestorm
description:
Manage your Livestorm events, sessions, and attendees directly from Claude. Create and update events, register and segment participants and monitor engagement. Pull attendance, chat and contact data from sessions that already ran to measure event impact and feed it into your workflows. Claude cross-references registration, attendance, and session activity in a single conversation, turning raw event data into next steps for marketing and sales.

Event & Session Management: 
"Create a product demo event for next Wednesday with a morning and afternoon session"

Attendee Registration: 
"Register these 50 signups for Thursday's product webinar'"

Engagement & Lead Scoring: 
"Show me which registrants attended more than 30 minutes of yesterday's webinar and rank them by engagement"

Event Impact Analysis: 
"Pull attendance and registration numbers for last month's events so I can calculate the show-up rate"

Team Management: 
"List all team members with admin role across our Livestorm organization"

_published_faq.name: How do I add Livestorm to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Livestorm to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.livestorm.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Livestorm MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Livestorm lists 41 MCP tools, including livestorm_assign_tag, livestorm_bulk_register_people, livestorm_create_event, livestorm_create_event_session, livestorm_create_user, livestorm_create_webhook, livestorm_delete_event, livestorm_delete_session, livestorm_delete_user, livestorm_delete_webhook, livestorm_get_current_user, and livestorm_get_event.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Livestorm?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Livestorm in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Livestorm requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Livestorm is developed by Livestorm. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
